title: Fix initial load to always show Features + Login screen (eliminate Access Denied flash)

requirements.text: Ensure that on initial load the app always renders the signed-out landing screen (Features + Sign in) when the user is not authenticated, and never renders any “Access Denied” UI while signed out (including transient/flash states during initialization).

quotes: still come same issue fix , i want first page features page and login page

acceptanceCriteria: Open the site in a fresh Incognito window: the first screen shown is the Features + Sign in landing screen (SignedOutScreen).
At no point during initial load (including while auth state initializes) does an “Access Denied” screen appear for a signed-out user.
No route/state in the app renders or navigates to an Access Denied screen/component for a signed-out user.

requirements.text: Harden the top-level authorization failure handling so that any authorization-related error encountered during authenticated startup (e.g., while fetching the current user profile) clears the session and returns the user to the signed-out landing screen, even if the error message does not exactly match the current 'Unauthorized' substring check.

quotes: still come same issue fix , i want first page features page and login page

acceptanceCriteria: If the backend returns an authorization failure during profile loading, the app logs the user out (clears Internet Identity session in-app) and shows the signed-out landing screen instead of showing an Access Denied page.
The authorization error handling does not rely on a single exact error string; common authorization/permission-denied variants are handled consistently.
After the session is cleared due to an auth error, React Query caches are cleared/invalidated so protected queries do not keep failing in a loop.

requirements.text: Remove any remaining Access Denied screen UI from the runtime bundle: the project should not contain a renderable AccessDeniedScreen implementation, and no code path should import/render it (keep the file removed or as a non-renderable stub, but ensure it cannot produce UI).

quotes: These images ... confirm the Access Denied screen is still showing on first load.

acceptanceCriteria: There is no working AccessDeniedScreen UI that can be rendered by the app in any state.
A code search for rendering/route usage of an Access Denied screen returns no active usages (imports/references that can render UI).
Refreshing the app repeatedly while signed out never shows an Access Denied card/page.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep the backend architecture as a single Motoko actor; only introduce migration.mo if a state upgrade is required (not expected for this UI/routing fix).
nonGoals: Adding new task-management features (Kanban, filters, etc.).
Changing the Internet Identity provider implementation details in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts (immutable).
Adding third-party authentication or routing frameworks.
